meta.dataset: ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III (Kaggle): train.csv, building_metadata.csv, weather_train.csv

methods.units: Kaggle units per site/meter from the Building Data Genome 2 wiki; converted to kWh where a factor exists.
methods.weather_alignment: Weather timestamps shifted from UTC to site-local time with per-site offsets.
methods.fit_quality: ASHRAE Guideline 14 CV(RMSE) and NMBE on out-of-sample predictions (hourly <=30 % / +-10 %, monthly <=15 % / +-5 %).
methods.anomalies: Daily residual robust z-score >= 3.0 and difference >= 15 %, days with >= 20 valid hours, consecutive days merged (1-day gap).
methods.expected_range: Expected total +- 1.96 x robust daily residual SD x sqrt(days); approximate (ignores autocorrelation).
methods.peers: Same meter, >= 80 % coverage; same site and use first, then same use at other sites (verified/converted kWh only, floor area within 1/3x-3x), then same site any use; needs >= 5 peers.
methods.data_quality: Missing runs >= 24 h, electricity zero runs >= 24 h, flat-lines >= 48 h, thermal zero runs >= 168 h.
